overview: The paper proposes XTF, a framework that filters token-level noise in LLM fine-tuning datasets by decomposing token contributions into Reasoning Importance, Knowledge Novelty, and Task Relevance, using explainable scoring and statistical thresholding to mask gradients of noisy tokens for optimized fine-tuning.

modules.name: Dataset Formatting and Tokenization
modules.description: Handles the loading, cleaning, and tokenization of raw downstream task data (math, code, medicine, finance) into standard input-output pairs, constructing the base datasets required for subsequent token-level scoring and fine-tuning.

modules.name: Reasoning Importance (RI) Scoring
modules.description: Implements the extraction of attention weights from the base LLM by feeding the concatenated input and label, computing the reasoning importance score for each token in the output label based on the model's attention distribution.

modules.name: Knowledge Novelty (KN) Scoring
modules.description: Implements the calculation of the Probability of Correct Prediction (PCP) using the base LLM's forward pass over the context and label, computing the knowledge novelty score by assessing how novel the token's knowledge is to the base model.

modules.name: Task Relevance (TR) Scoring
modules.description: Constructs the task domain vector using the average embeddings of dataset samples from the base model, then computes the semantic distance between context-free token embeddings and the domain vector to derive the task relevance score for each token.

modules.name: Adaptive Thresholding and Noise Masking
modules.description: Applies distribution-specific statistical methods (Quantile/IQR for RI, Heuristic thresholding for KN, and Multi-Otsu clustering for TR) to identify noisy tokens in each dimension, and generates the final binary noise mask by taking the union of tokens identified as lacking in any attribute.

modules.name: XTF Data Collation
modules.description: Integrates the generated noise masks with the tokenized dataset, replacing the labels of noisy tokens with the ignore index (e.g., -100) so that their gradients are masked during the loss computation in the fine-tuning phase.

modules.name: XTF-Optimized Fine-Tuning Engine
modules.description: Manages the LLM fine-tuning loop using the processed datasets with masked labels, supporting both full-parameter and LoRA fine-tuning regimes, and ensuring the loss function ignores the contribution of filtered noisy tokens.

modules.name: Multi-Metric Evaluation and Judge Integration
modules.description: Evaluates the fine-tuned models on downstream tasks, computing accuracy for math, medicine, and finance tasks using an LLM-based judge model to verify correctness, and calculating Pass@k metrics for code generation tasks.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates controlled experiments to validate the contribution of individual scoring attributes (RI, KN, TR) and their combinations, and conducts sensitivity analysis on thresholding parameters by perturbing the percentage of filtered tokens.

modules.name: Experiment Tracking and Resource Profiling
modules.description: Handles configuration management for different models and tasks, logs training metrics and evaluation results, and profiles computational overhead (GPU memory usage and inference time) for the XTF scoring process compared to baselines.
